why_reasons.title: Top 2 SKUs account for 100% of portfolio opportunity
why_reasons.body: HX9911/89, HX9911/79 together drive 100% of the total profit uplift (+2,836.40 €). Concentrate promo investment on these for highest impact.

why_reasons.title: Weeks 42–46 are your highest-elasticity window
why_reasons.body: The causal model shows strongest price response in weeks 42–46 — 1,048.73 € incremental profit available here. Concentrate promo activity in this window.

why_reasons.title: Optimal depth averages 12% across the portfolio
why_reasons.body: The causal response curve is concave — beyond 12% discount, additional depth adds cost without meaningful volume gain.
